title: Python: review follow-ups after E1, (a29), (a30) and N3
description: Non-blocking items owed from the #149, #152 and #150 reviews: OSError wording in the instanceClassOf docstring (returns an instance of the subclass being constructed); the GCLI-99 finalSummary correction (five mutation checks, reversed excluded); receiverNeedsInference counts on the notBuiltin and shadowedInOwner fixtures; a real call-site-scope mutant for the owner-scope check; N3 minor fixtures (tuple and star-unpack targets, comprehension variable, parameter named x, closure call, plain import x, nonlocal one level) and the found.scope-to-scope and polymorphicCheck mutants.
